newsitem.title: USA: Abbott Labs to settle FTC charges - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Abbott Labs to settle FTC charges - WSJ.

text.p: Advertisements by Abbott Laboratories Inc for its Ensure nutritional beverage included "false and unsubstantiated claims," the Federal Trade Commission charged Thursday, according to Friday's edition of The Wall Street Journal.

The FTC says the company's marketing claim that the drink is recommended by many doctors as a meal supplement and replacement for healthy adults, including those in their 30s and 40s, constituted deceptive advertising, the story says.
Abbott has agreed to settle the charges by backing off the use of endorsements from medical professionals, unless it can produce evidence to substantiate the claims, the story says.
